content: The customer, Dev Chatterjee, inquired about the status of his expired health policy (HP-34219) and whether it could be reactivated automatically. The insurance agent, Suresh Deshmukh, informed him that auto-reactivation is not possible and that a renewal application or a new policy is required. The customer then requested the coverage summary PDF, which the agent successfully resent.

action_items: Submit a renewal application or choose a new policy
